summary: @ornikar/renovate-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: This version of @ornikar/renovate-config, advertised as a Renovate shared configuration package, ships a preinstall hook that runs node setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it 0o755, and uses it to execFileSync a sibling file math_init.js (~727KB) that is heavily obfuscated (hex-named identifiers _0xXXXX, a rotated 700+ element string array with rotator WV8StW and index decoder hc1jfK9). Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are obfuscated, and the shipped math_init.js is not human-readable without executing its string-array decoder. A Renovate shared-config package legitimately contains only JSON; there is no functional reason to fetch a second language runtime and execute an obfuscated payload at install time. Installing this version causes an alternate-runtime dropper to run attacker-authored code on the installer's machine on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
